info.name: Hercules DJControl Inpulse T7
info.author: Infinite-Grok
info.description: Mapping for the Hercules DJControl Inpulse T7: two decks with motorized platters, performance pads, effects and the mixer section.

control.description: PLAY/PAUSE, deck 1: play or pause, and start or stop the motor
SHIFT, deck 1: remembers that SHIFT is held
SYNC, deck 1: sync on or off
SHIFT + SYNC, deck 1: make this deck the sync leader
CUE, deck 1: cue; hold to preview
SHIFT + CUE, deck 1: go to the cue point and stop
SHIFT + PLAY, deck 1: play from the cue point, stop on release
IN, deck 1: set the loop start
SHIFT + IN, deck 1: halve the loop
OUT, deck 1: set the loop end
SHIFT + OUT, deck 1: double the loop
Headphone button, deck 1: send this deck to the headphones
Browser knob push, deck 1: load the selected track
SHIFT + browser knob push, deck 1: load the selected track
AUTOLOOP knob push, deck 1: start a loop, or leave the running loop
SHIFT + AUTOLOOP knob push, deck 1: delete the loop
ASSIST/PREP, deck 1: open the selected library item
SHIFT + ASSIST/PREP, deck 1: add the selected track to the Auto DJ list
BACK, deck 1: move the library cursor back to the left
SHIFT + BACK, deck 1: show or hide the large library view
RANGE, deck 1: step the tempo fader range
SHIFT + RANGE, deck 1: key lock on or off
PARAM right, deck 1: speed up while held
PARAM left, deck 1: slow down while held
SHIFT + PARAM right, deck 1: ends the speed-up if SHIFT was pressed while held
SHIFT + PARAM left, deck 1: ends the slow-down if SHIFT was pressed while held
FX lever, deck 1: effect unit on while held
FX lever, deck 1: effect unit on while held
FX lever, deck 1: effect unit on while held
FX lever, deck 1: effect unit on while held
FX lever, deck 1, SHIFT held: effect unit on while held
Pad page 5, deck 1: mode 5 (SHIFT + HOT CUE)
AUTOLOOP knob, deck 1: double or halve the loop, or set the next loop size
SHIFT + AUTOLOOP knob, deck 1: move the loop, or set the beat jump size
Browser knob, deck 1: move through the track list
SHIFT + browser knob, deck 1: move ten rows at a time
Channel fader, deck 1, high bits, SHIFT held
Channel fader, deck 1, low bits, SHIFT held
Low EQ knob, deck 1, high bits
Low EQ knob, deck 1, low bits
Mid EQ knob, deck 1, high bits
Mid EQ knob, deck 1, low bits
High EQ knob, deck 1, high bits
High EQ knob, deck 1, low bits
Tempo fader, deck 1, high bits, SHIFT held
Tempo fader, deck 1, low bits, SHIFT held

SHIFT, deck 2: remembers that SHIFT is held
SYNC, deck 2: sync on or off
SHIFT + SYNC, deck 2: make this deck the sync leader
CUE, deck 2: cue; hold to preview
SHIFT + CUE, deck 2: go to the cue point and stop
SHIFT + PLAY, deck 2: play from the cue point, stop on release
IN, deck 2: set the loop start
SHIFT + IN, deck 2: halve the loop
OUT, deck 2: set the loop end
SHIFT + OUT, deck 2: double the loop
Headphone button, deck 2: send this deck to the headphones

SHIFT + AUTOLOOP knob push, deck 2: delete the loop
ASSIST/PREP, deck 2: open the selected library item
SHIFT + ASSIST/PREP, deck 2: add the selected track to the Auto DJ list
BACK, deck 2: move the library cursor back to the left
SHIFT + BACK, deck 2: show or hide the large library view
RANGE, deck 2: step the tempo fader range
SHIFT + RANGE, deck 2: key lock on or off
PARAM right, deck 2: speed up while held
PARAM left, deck 2: slow down while held
SHIFT + PARAM right, deck 2: ends the speed-up if SHIFT was pressed while held
SHIFT + PARAM left, deck 2: ends the slow-down if SHIFT was pressed while held

FX lever, deck 2: effect unit on while held

Pad page 5, deck 2: mode 5 (SHIFT + HOT CUE)
AUTOLOOP knob, deck 2: double or halve the loop, or set the next loop size

Browser knob, deck 2: move through the track list
